description: This file defines the 'Resource' interface within the Eclipse Ditto project. It represents a resource in a policy model, including methods to create instances, access attributes like type and path, and serialize to JSON. It also includes inner classes for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: Resource.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains definitions of JSON fields related to the Resource structure, including schema version.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory methods to create new Resource instances with different parameters.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the supported JSON schema versions for Resource, specifically only version V_2.

methods.name: getResourceKey
methods.description: Retrieves the resource key identifying this resource.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the resource.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Retrieves the JSON pointer path of the resource.

methods.name: getFullQualifiedPath
methods.description: Returns the full qualified resource path combining type and path.

methods.name: getEffectedPermissions
methods.description: Gets the permissions (granted or revoked) associated with this resource.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the resource to a JSON object, including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Serializes the resource to JSON with specific schema version and field selection.
